record.question: From next academic year, the state is going to introduce English medium from 1st- 8th standard in government schools
record.explanation: Answer D: Andhra Pradesh. The state was Andhra Pradesh; its government announced English-medium instruction in government schools from academic year 2020–21. The original plan covered classes 1–8; later orders modified implementation, so this is anchored to the November–December 2019 announcement. Reference: https://diksha.gov.in/ap/emic.html; https://www.asianage.com/india/politics/120919/andhra-govt-to-introduce-english-medium-from-next-academic-year.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
